correctness.rationale: Laurent monomials z^{q-1}w^k have finite squared norm π²m/(qs) exactly when q>=1 and s=m(k+1)+nq>=1. Restricting the two radial integrations to |z|<a|w|^{n/m}, |w|<a^m multiplies that norm by a^{2(q+s)}, so the positive Toeplitz spectrum is the complete congruence lattice s≡nq mod m, with q,s>=1. Residue partition q=r+mj,s=ρ_r+mk gives the rational generating function and positivity, compactness and every p>0 Schatten membership. Expanding numerator and (1-t^m)^{-2} verifies Dedekind finite part; independent symbolic expansions for coprime pairs (1,1),(2,1),(3,1),(5,1),(5,2),(5,3),(7,3) agreed identically. Coordinate swap gives inverse-residue isospectrality; congruence shell count and triangular lattice counting yield missing shells and N(ε)=log²(1/ε)/(8m log²(1/a))+O(log(1/ε)). Infinite claims follow exact integrals and lattice counting, not finite tests.
